title: Zimbabwe Homecoming — EN/SN/ES (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Spanish heritage homecoming diaspora
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
When we go back to Zimbabwe the airport smells the same
As it did the day we left — and something answers to its name
Inside the chest before the customs, before the bags
The homecoming is already happening in the recognition flags

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Patinodzoka kuZimbabwe airport inhanhu yakafanana
[When we return to Zimbabwe the airport smells the same]
Sezvainhanhu musi watakabva — chitendero chakafanana
[As it smelled the day we left — the same recognition]
Zviri mukati mechifuva kupfura customs uye mabhegi
[It is inside the chest before customs and the bags]
Kudzoka kumba kwatove kutanga pane zviratidzo zvose
[The homecoming has already begun with all the signals]

[Chorus — English]
Zimbabwe homecoming, Zimbabwe homecoming
The red dust on the road and the msasa trees are coming
Zimbabwe homecoming — the place where everything began
Is still the place that knows you better than any other can
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
Cuando regresamos a Zimbabwe el aeropuerto huele igual
[When we return to Zimbabwe the airport smells the same]
Como el día que partimos — el reconocimiento es total
[As the day we left — the recognition is total]
Está en el pecho antes de la aduana y el equipaje
[It is in the chest before customs and the luggage]
El regreso a casa ya ha comenzado en el aterrizaje
[The homecoming has already begun at the landing]

[Outro — All three languages]
Zimbabwe homecoming… Kudzoka kuZimbabwe… Regreso a Zimbabwe
The dust remembers — Guruva rinoyeuka — El polvo recuerda
The gardens still growing
